If someone gave you £500,000 and said, “Go and buy a commercial property”, 

Would you know where to start?

Most people probably wouldn’t.

Not because commercial property is impossible to understand, but because there are a lot of things you simply don’t come across in residential property.

So let’s see where people actually feel the biggest gap.
